payload.text:
The dot-com bubble was one of the biggest tech booms in history.
[pause]
Investors poured money into internet startups, often before they had profits, or even a viable business.
[pause]
From 1995 to 2000, the Nasdaq rose almost 400%.
[pause]
Then reality caught up. In 2000, the bubble burst, and tech stocks collapsed.
[pause]
Thousands of companies disappeared, and trillions of dollars in market value were wiped out.
[pause]
But the internet survived, and companies like Amazon emerged stronger.

segments.text: The dot-com bubble was one of the biggest tech booms in history.
Investors poured money into internet startups, often before they had profits, or even a viable business.
From 1995 to 2000, the Nasdaq rose almost 400%.
Then reality caught up. In 2000, the bubble burst, and tech stocks collapsed.
Thousands of companies disappeared, and trillions of dollars in market value were wiped out.
But the internet survived, and companies like Amazon emerged stronger.
